title: transcript.line.v1: one line of a session's transcript
description: PUBLIC record. A PROJECTION of event.v1 for a linear reader (the terminal client's plain mode, a screen reader, a golden file in a test). It is not the wire event and carries less: events.read with projection 'transcript' returns these lines, written as JSON Lines, one line for each event in order. The mapping from an event: seq is the event's seq. time_rel_ms is the event's time minus the time of the first event of the log, in milliseconds (in a test, from the test clock). event_type, source and trust are the event's type, source and trust. state is the state word the event reports, or null: for state.changed its 'to'; for turn.ended its state; for approval.answered its state; for stop.result its code; for steer.queued its state; for interrupt its phase; null for every other type. text is the event's text for a reader, or null when the event has none: for engine.output and turn.started the payload's text; for tool.result its text (null when the output was put aside); for result its detail; for every other type a short sentence written by the core's own renderer from the payload's typed fields. Text that came from an engine or a plugin is passed through the core's sanitizer and stays marked 'untrusted'; no line with trust 'untrusted' may open an approval. speech is what a screen reader is asked to say for this line, or null when nothing is to be announced (a condition is announced when it appears, changes or clears, not on every line). focus names where input goes after this line ('composer', 'approval', 'transcript', 'list'), or null when the line does not move it.
